summary.text: Places maps the supported IDs oslo, helsinki, and lisbon to canonical Place records for Oslo, Helsinki, and Lisbon, exposes HTTP actions for listing, saving, and requesting a refresh, and checks database readiness. The repository stores places and durable request_outbox rows; RequestPublisher sends pending place.requested events to Kafka. This service source view does not document forecast recomputation or dashboard-card updates.

[HttpGet("/places")]
    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<Place>> List(CancellationToken token) => await repository.List(token);

places-24afabf4ce6fb0dad4a7.text: public async Task<Place?> Find(string id, CancellationToken token) => (await List(token)).FirstOrDefault(place => place.Id == id);
